# Design Audit

## Screen 1 — Doctor listing/search results

**a) Canvas color:** Neutral white / near-white. White background with white cards delineated by thin gray borders and rounded corners — not cream/beige.

**b) Avatars:** Real face photos. All six visible doctors have actual headshots (varied backgrounds — white, gray, red). No gray placeholder squares anywhere. Minor inconsistency: avatar shapes/crops vary (square vs. rounded-rect vs. tight crop) — worth standardizing to one mask (e.g., circle or 16px-radius square).

**c) Color system:** Effectively monochrome, but **no teal accent**. Everything is black/gray/white: black text, gray secondary text, pale gray pill buttons ("Book"), light-gray chips ("Back", "All cities"). Price and "12 doctors found" are plain black/gray. If the design system includes teal (as screen 2 does), it's missing here — the only accent is the red photo backgrounds, which are incidental, not system colors.

**d) Defects:**
- **Last card clipped:** "Dr. Pack Test" card is cut mid-card at the viewport bottom (price row and Book button partially cut) — likely just scroll position, but the book button is half-visible, creating an ambiguous tap target.
- No other clipping or broken layouts. Buttons are visible and legible. Minor nit: Book buttons are very low-contrast (light gray pill, dark text) — weak affordance for the primary action; consider a filled/accent style.

## Screen 2 — Doctor booking sheet

**a) Canvas color:** Neutral white. White sheet over a dimmed/gray backdrop showing the listing page behind. Not cream.

**b) Avatars:** **Gray square** — "DR" initials placeholder, no real photo. Inconsistent with screen 1, where Rajesh has a photo. Should reuse the doctor's avatar for continuity.

**c) Color system:** Monochrome + teal accent — yes. Black/white/gray base (black "Tomorrow" chip, black "Confirm slot" button), with teal used for the selected slot (09:00 — teal border, light teal fill, teal text) and the "11/23 · 09:00" summary text in teal. Consistent with a monochrome + teal system; screen 1 is the outlier missing the accent.

**d) Defects:**
- **Clipped date chip:** A fifth date chip on the right (11/26?) is cut off at the screen edge — intentional horizontal scroll affordance, but there's no partial-content cue beyond the cut itself; acceptable, though a fade/gradient would help.
- "Today" chip appears disabled (gray text) — fine, but the gray-on-gray disabled state is low contrast.
- No broken layouts; time slot grid is clean and evenly spaced. "Confirm slot" is high-contrast and clearly tappable.

## Cross-screen summary
- **Consistent:** white canvas, black/white monochrome base, pill-shaped components.
- **Inconsistent:** teal accent used only on the booking sheet, not the listing; avatar treatment (photo on listing, gray initials square on sheet); Book buttons pale/low-contrast.
- **Fix priority:** (1) add teal accent to listing CTAs, (2) pass doctor photo into the sheet header, (3) unify avatar masks.
